quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE TARGET CONSONANT PHONEME IN THE WORD
quests.hint: "jell" is a longer or less common word — don't let the spelling distract you. Isolate just the target consonant sound.
quests.explanation: In "jell", the target sound is /dʒ/, made by stopping the airflow completely, then releasing it as a hiss, with the voice on. The distractor /j/ would instead require gliding the tongue up close to the roof of the mouth, like starting to say 'ee' — a clearly different sound once you isolate it.
